name: FABER BRAIN EXTRACTION TEST 10/26/26
summary: Skull-strips a T1-weighted image with FSL bet, with a configurable fractional intensity threshold and optional robust centre estimation or bias-field and neck cleanup.
description: Wraps FSL bet (container brainlife/fsl:5.0.11) on a T1w volume; frac sets the fractional intensity threshold, robust adds -R and bias_neck_cleanup adds -B. Use it for quick T1w brain extraction. Warning: on this branch main calls brain_extract.py without arguments (the config adapter run_bet.sh is never called) and then checks an out_dir folder the script does not write, so the App fails as committed.

outputs.description: Skull-stripped T1w volume produced by FSL BET.

parameters.description: BET fractional intensity threshold (0-1). Lower values give larger brain outlines.
Use robust brain centre estimation (slower, may improve difficult cases).

failure_modes.fix: main runs brain_extract.py with no arguments; it must call run_bet.sh (which reads config.json) and write to the output folder main checks.
